items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I had this boy, Herbert Horace, playing high note and Henry.

ctx.x: Of course he's a progressive, you know. He's not. So I had him in the band and my little boy Charles Gabriel in the band playing tenor. August playing trumpet three boys. August and Mauret. And then I used him in the brass band. I had this boy, Herbert Horace, playing high note and Henry. Henry Jarvis, he was playing tenor. I would play the Alpes, so that was four. But Alpes could play clarinet, but that Henry Jarvis, we had three clarinets we played. He could play the tenor, he couldn't play the clarinet. But…
